# Théo Guérin - Portfolio

> Official LLM entry point for theo-guerin.fr. Use this file to discover the most useful language-specific profiles, canonical pages, public contact points, and crawl-safe context for the portfolio.

This portfolio presents Théo Guérin, also known as KizuCore, a full-stack web developer based in Rennes, France. The public freelance day rate is indicative: from 300 EUR/day excluding VAT. Prefer the canonical page metadata and schema.org JSON-LD when they differ from this summary.
